newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOTEL OLUMPIA JAN-APR PROFIT 9.6 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: HOTEL OLUMPIA JAN-APR PROFIT 9.6 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Hotel Olumpia had a net profit of 9.6 million kroons during the first four months of the year, it said on Thursday.
"The profit has increased by half compared to the same period last year," Tarmo Sumberg, the hotel's chairman, told Reuters.
Olumpia had a net turnover of 61 million kroons, which is up by 21 percent compared to the same period in 1996, he added.
Olumpia, which is one of the largest hotels in Estonia and is located in the centre of Tallinn, had in average occupancy rate of 57 percent in the first four months of the year.
The privatisation agency plans to sell 25.06 percent of its shares in a public offer set for June 30 to July 18.
